text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thirty-five parliamentarians sign proposal to make Islam the only source of legislation.
- Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan expects state spending to rise by 100 million dinars ($333 million) in 1997/98 July-June fiscal year.
- Public Works Minister Abdulla al-Hajri approves reshuffle among ministry officials.
- Civil Service Commission restricts state jobs to university graduates.
- Government drafts bill seeking authority to increase charges on state services.
- Kuwait to sign investment protection accord with Belgium in May of 1997.
- Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad al-Khaled al-Sabah met with the ministry's human rights committee on Wednesday.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah hopes for Qatar-Bahrain agreement.
